definitions.explanation: The act of selecting with great care and strict standards. Commonly used in marketing and advertising to emphasize quality.

examples.japanese: {厳選|げんせん}された{素材|そざい}を{使|つか}っている。
{全国|ぜんこく}から{厳選|げんせん}した{食材|しょくざい}を{取|と}り{寄|よ}せた。
examples.english: We sourced carefully selected ingredients from across the country.

examples.japanese: {百|ひゃく}を{超|こ}える{応募|おうぼ}の{中|なか}から{厳選|げんせん}された{十作品|じっさくひん}が{展示|てんじ}された。
examples.english: Ten works carefully selected from over a hundred entries were exhibited.

notes:
Also functions as a する verb ({厳選|げんせん}する). Very common in advertising, restaurant descriptions, and product marketing to convey premium quality. The past participle form {厳選|げんせん}された is especially frequent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{厳選|げんせん}された{素材|そざい} — carefully selected materials
・{厳選|げんせん}{食材|しょくざい} — handpicked ingredients
・{厳選|げんせん}した{商品|しょうひん} — carefully chosen products

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{選|えら}び{抜|ぬ}く — to select with care (native Japanese equivalent)
・{精選|せいせん} — careful selection (less common)
